game_title: Vowel Counter – Ice Cave Shelter Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter, a shelter in an ice cave: the mountaineer must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter: a shelter in an ice cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Cave Shelter, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the vowels value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the flag pole using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The flag pole reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the flag pole is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Vowel Counter' (Week 8 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ice Cave Shelter'. code_snippet:
for ch in word:
    if ch in 'aeiou':
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vowels changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Ice Cave Shelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The flag pole reached with actions_used <= 14.
